claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch four astronauts around the Moon.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch from Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed mission.
Artemis II follows the successful uncrewed Artemis I in 2022.
